To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the QSMTS- IP heuristic is the best choice when there is a high number of users and the tasks are soft or best-efforts.
the QSMTS- IP heuristic performs better than the other heuristics in the majority of the scenarios considered in this study
the genetic algorithm heuristic is the best suited for the QoS-based meta-task scheduling problem in HC environments.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of scheduling tasks with multiple QoS requirements in a heterogeneous environment.
the problem of scheduling a metatask with multiple QoS attributes, such as versions, security, timeliness and reliability in an HC environment.
the development of a QoS model for heterogeneous distributed computing environments.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
no single heuristic is superior to all others, and hence, the choice of heuristic depends on the HC environment.
there is no best heuristic, and each heuristic has its own merits and demerits, which should be taken into account when selecting a heuristic for a particular HC environment.
the QSMTS- IP heuristic is the best suited for most of the cases studied in this paper.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the QSMTS-IPS heuristic is a good general purpose heuristic, while sufferage is a good heuristic for soft real-time tasks with tight deadlines.
the genetic algorithm is a good choice when the number of users is high.
the min-min heuristic is the best suited for the HC environment where the tasks have soft QoS needs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the choice of a heuristic depends on a number of factors such as the type of QoS dimensions, the degree of tightness of deadlines, and the service-types of the tasks.
the best heuristic to be used in a given HC setting is a function of the QoS requirements of the task set, the service-type of each task, the degree of tightness of the deadlines and the QoS model.
the best heuristic to choose depends on the nature of the tasks and the HC environment.
